source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Ipconfig and ifconfig Commands' (PDF 18): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Ipconfig Windows operating system mein istemal hoti hai. Ifconfig Linux aur macOS systems mein istemal hoti hai. Yeh commands network settings dikhati hain. Yeh IP address aur subnet mask (address ka kaun sa hissa network ka hai, yeh batane wala number) dikhati hain. Yeh gateway aur network status (halat) bhi dikhati hain. Yeh commands network troubleshooting mein madad deti hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Windows mein Start mein "cmd" likh kar command prompt kholein aur "ipconfig" likhein. Wahan "IPv4 Address", "Subnet Mask" aur "Default Gateway" nazar aayenge.

blocks.prompt: Windows aur Linux par IP settings dekhne ki commands kaun si hain, aur yeh kya dikhati hain?
blocks.explanation: Windows: ipconfig; Linux/macOS: ifconfig. Yeh IP address, subnet mask, gateway aur network status dikhati hain.

items: ipconfig (Windows) / ifconfig (Linux, macOS): IP address, subnet mask, gateway, status; troubleshooting mein madad.
